presentation.label: Diarrhoea
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us about your symptoms and when they started.

questions.question: How many times have you opened your bowels in the last 24 hours?
How would you describe your stools - are they loose, watery or solid?
Have you noticed any blood in your stools?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has noticed blood in their stools?

questions.question: Do you have stomach pain or cramps?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has stomach pain or cramps?

questions.question: Have you been vomiting?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has been vomiting?

questions.question: Have you had a fever?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has had a fever?

questions.question: Have you travelled abroad recently?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has travelled abroad recently?

questions.question: Have you been able to keep down fluids?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has been able to keep down fluids?

questions.question: Have you taken any antibiotics recently?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has taken antibiotics recently?

questions.question: How long have you had diarrhoea?

unable_to_keep_down_fluid_safety.message: This form is for routine issues and it may take several days to receive a response. If you are unable to keep down fluids, phone the duty doctor instead of submitting this form.
